Aisha (Finance): Heads up — invoice batch run for 2026-03-22 produced invoices with missing surcharge line items and a small set of duplicate invoice IDs. Affected customers: Veratone, Zenith Labs, and one marketplace vendor. Sample invoice_id: INV-20260322-8791 (surcharge missing)

Sam (Billing Eng): Can you paste the export or the job logs? I can triage.

Aisha (Finance): Pasting a snippet from the job-run CSV/logs: 
```
WARN 2026-03-22T04:12:33Z invoice-generator Job(463) tenant=veratone invoice_id=INV-20260322-8791 - line_items=[] total=1200.00
ERROR 2026-03-22T04:12:33Z invoice-generator validation: missing_required_lines: surcharge_line not found for invoice INV-20260322-8791
INFO 2026-03-22T04:12:34Z invoice-generator Duplicate detected: invoice_key_hash=0x9f3ac4 tenant=zenith invoice_ids=[INV-20260322-8820, INV-20260322-8820]
```

billing-bot: InvoiceJob #463 status=partial_failure tenants=[veratone,zenith,market-vendor-11] failures=18 duplicates=3 missing_line_items=12

Raj (Payments): Do we know if any of those PDFs/emails already went out? If yes we need to stop collection and prepare void/credit flows.

Lina (Support): Veratone just opened a ticket — they say they received two PDFs and amounts don't match. I asked for the invoice numbers and they sent INV-20260322-8791 and INV-20260322-8791 (same id) but the totals differ.

Sam (Billing Eng): Reproduced locally — looks like a join race between pricing-experiments table and proration step. If pricing_adjustments join returns null we drop surcharge rows. Quick query shows missing rows where pricing_experiment_id IS NOT NULL AND last_modified > job_start_ms.

Sam (Billing Eng): Snippet of problematic SQL used by generator: 
```
SELECT li.* FROM line_items li
LEFT JOIN pricing_adjustments pa ON (li.sku = pa.sku AND pa.active = true)
WHERE li.amount_cents > 0 AND NOT pa.experiment_disabled
-- missing filter on pa.effective_ts <= invoice_period_end
```

Aisha (Finance): OK — steps: 1) pause send for the affected tenant list, 2) patch billing service to restrict pricing_adjustment join by effective_ts, 3) rerun generator in dry-run to confirm lines reappear, 4) if PDFs were sent, prepare void + corrected invoice + customer notice. Assign owner?

Sam (Billing Eng): I'll own deploy and dry-run. Pushing branch fix/surcharge-join now, will run dry-run in staging against the affected tenant snapshots. ETA ~45m.

Raj (Payments): Holding any automatic collection / dunning for those tenant IDs. I'll prepare void templates in case we need to issue corrected invoices.

Lina (Support): I'll message Veratone and tell them we're investigating and will pause any payment activity. Added ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-5238

Aisha (Finance): Putting a temporary stop-send flag on tenants: veratone, zenith, market-vendor-11. Do not run nightly send for them until Sam confirms dry-run.

Sam (Billing Eng): Dry-run complete: 12 invoices would be regenerated. Surcharge lines restored for INV-20260322-8791 and others. No duplicate invoice_id generated after fix. Will schedule a targeted regen + pdf reissue once approved.

Aisha (Finance): Great — thanks Sam. I'll coordinate approvals for reissue and customer outreach (finance + support).

Raj (Payments): Thanks — I'll wait for your go to trigger void + reissue.

Lina (Support): Noted, updating Veratone ticket and closing the loop with the client. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Incident note added to billing-ops: #BILL-2026-03-22-INV-GLITCH (partial failure, in mitigation)
